configurations.name: rh-server
runtimeArgs: LAN_IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null || true); K=$(grep -E '^PYTH_API_KEY=' .env 2>/dev/null | head -1 | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"' | tr -d '\r'); env ${K:+PYTH_API_KEY=$K} DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=/dev/null CHAIN_FAMILY=evm REAL_MONEY_ENABLED=false CORS_ORIGINS="http://localhost:3100,http://127.0.0.1:3100${LAN_IP:+,http://$LAN_IP:3100}" SIGNUP_FAUCET=true DEV_ENDPOINTS=true PORT=8099 NODE_ENV=development npx tsx src/index.ts

configurations.name: rh-web
runtimeArgs: LAN_IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null || echo localhost); VITE_API_BASE=http://$LAN_IP:8099 VITE_WALLET=dev npm run dev -- --port 3100 --strictPort --host

configurations.name: perps-server
runtimeArgs: LAN_IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null || true); REAL_MONEY_ENABLED=false CORS_ORIGINS="http://localhost:4000,http://127.0.0.1:4000,http://localhost:4100,http://127.0.0.1:4100,http://localhost:4333,http://127.0.0.1:4333${LAN_IP:+,http://$LAN_IP:4000,http://$LAN_IP:4100,http://$LAN_IP:4333}" SIGNUP_FAUCET=true DEV_ENDPOINTS=true PORT=8081 NODE_ENV=development npx tsx src/index.ts
